_help: Companion barks: short in-play lines by speaker and situation (lines with an 'if' are tried first when it passes; '_any' is the fallback). Played by scripts/barks.gd. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_barks.py.

combat_start.text: Oh God. Right. Right, I can do this.
Keep them off the inscriptions if you can!
Behind you! I'll watch your back.

reloading.text: I'm out. How do you do this so quickly?

ally_down.text: No, no, no. Stay with me!

enemy_down.text: I hit it. I actually hit it.

low_health.text: I'm hurt. It's fine. It's mostly fine.
I need a moment. Just one.

helped_up.text: Thank you. I'm all right. Really.

mummy_seen.text: Those wrappings are Middle Kingdom. And it's moving.
Linen, resin, and it's walking toward us.

guardian_seen.text: The bound man from the reliefs. It's him.
That's the guardian. The inscriptions were literal.

scarabs.text: Scarabs! Don't let them touch your skin!
They're coming out of the walls!

entering_tomb.text: No one has breathed this air for three thousand years.
Mind where you step. Everything here matters.

idle_explore.text: Look at the tool marks. They rushed this wall.
I want a week with every one of these columns.
Whatever we find, it's ours to tell. Properly.

idle_city.text: The museum's that way. I'd rather not be seen.
Do you think the Professor knows I've gone?

campfire.text: I've filled half a notebook since Cairo.
Thank you for treating me like a scholar.

horse_ride.text: I've ridden in Hyde Park. This is not Hyde Park.
Is it supposed to bounce this much?

truck_ride.text: Every bump is another page of notes in the wrong order.
At least the trucks don't bite.

act5_escape.text: Run! Don't look back, just run!
The way out, which way is out?

act7_curse.text: The sky over Cairo, look at it. It's what the cradle said.
It's getting darker every hour. We're running out of time.

combat_start.text: This is not what I was engaged for.
Keep your heads down and your fire disciplined!

ally_down.text: Man down! Someone see to them!
We've lost one. Note the time.

enemy_down.text: Down. Do try not to damage the floor.

low_health.text: I'm wounded. Not badly. Not well, either.
I seem to be bleeding.

mummy_seen.text: That is... that cannot be.
There must be a rational explanation. It is still coming.

guardian_seen.text: Good Lord. It's real. All of it.
I shall need to revise a great deal.

slab_falling.text: It's dropping, get under it now!

entering_tomb.text: Nobody touches anything until it's recorded.
Photographs first. Then we breathe.

idle_explore.text: Roman sherds. Again.
Every find on paper, as agreed. Good.

idle_city.text: I know at least three of my creditors on this street.
Cairo never improves.

campfire.text: My record is up to date. Is yours?
Wadi Natrun still keeps me awake.

horse_ride.text: I am too old to be shaken like a cocktail.
This animal has no respect for scholarship.

truck_ride.text: Mind the crates, there are glass plates in those!
Slower, please, the negatives!

act7_curse.text: Some phenomena resist documentation.
I would very much like this to be a sandstorm.

combat_start.text: Stay behind the stone. Let them come to us.

reloading.text: A moment. My hands are old.

enemy_down.text: It is finished, for that one.

low_health.text: I am hurt. I have been hurt before.
Leave me a moment. I will follow.

helped_up.text: You did not have to come back for me.

mummy_seen.text: They are not dead. Not the way we mean it.
His servants. They walk ahead of him.

guardian_seen.text: Menkheper. He was a man, once.
Do not look him in the face. Shoot, and move.

scarabs.text: The scarabs keep the dead. Get back!
Do not stand still. They want stillness.

slab_falling.text: Under it, now, before it closes!

entering_tomb.text: Some doors were closed because those who built them understood what lay beyond.
We should not be here. You know that.

idle_explore.text: Read the walls before you read the gold.
They called it the Veil because it is only covered.

idle_city.text: My city. It still does not know what is coming.
Yacoub will be counting his books.

campfire.text: The stars were the same over the priests.
I owe you more than I can say.

horse_ride.text: Slowly. The desert is patient. So must we be.
I rode this road when I was young.

truck_ride.text: The old ones walked. I prefer this.
The sea on one side, the dead on the other.

act5_escape.text: He follows the amulet, not us. Run!

act7_curse.text: The second sign. The sky goes dark by day.
Stones from heaven. We are nearly out of time.

combat_start.text: Pick your targets. Make them count.
Lads, just like we drilled it!

low_health.text: I'm hit. Still in it.
Flesh wound. Keep firing.

mummy_seen.text: That's not a man. Shoot it anyway.
Aim for the legs, slow it down!

guardian_seen.text: Big one! Fall back and keep shooting!
Bullets slow it. Keep it slow!

scarabs.text: Bugs! Fire, use fire if you've got it!
Move, move, don't let them swarm you!

entering_tomb.text: One way in, so it's one way out. Remember that.
Torches up. Stay together.

idle_explore.text: Good ground for an ambush, this.
I'll take the rear.

idle_city.text: Club's round the corner. Later.
Keep your wallet in your front pocket.

campfire.text: I'll take first watch.
You're the kind of officer I'd follow.

horse_ride.text: Keep the column tight.
Eyes on the ridgeline.

truck_ride.text: Rifles ready. Trucks are a big target.
Somebody watch the rear.

act5_escape.text: Fall back! Fall back to the stairs!

act7_curse.text: Seen men panic before. Never a whole city.
Whatever's coming, we hold the line.

combat_start.text: Close in, quick, they do not like it close.

low_health.text: I am cut. I will live.
My sisters will be angry.

mummy_seen.text: I was hired to fight men with guns. Nobody mentioned the dead.
God protect us, it walks.

guardian_seen.text: That one I do not fight. That one I run from.
Do not let it grab you!

entering_tomb.text: Quiet places are where ambushes live.
I will go first. I am used to it.

idle_explore.text: Too quiet.
Someone has walked here before us. Recently.

idle_city.text: I know people in this street. Do not stop.
That man is a thief. So is that one.

campfire.text: My sisters would like the stars here.
You pay fair. That is rare.
Two hundred pounds. I have not forgotten.

horse_ride.text: Watch the high ground.
Good horses. Better than the merchants'.

truck_ride.text: Trucks are loud. Everyone will know we are coming.
Keep moving. Never stop on a road.

act7_curse.text: Even the thieves are praying now.
The city is afraid. Afraid people are dangerous.

combat_start.text: I'll take the left. Don't get in my way.

low_health.text: It's nothing. It's a scratch.
I've had worse. Not much worse.

helped_up.text: I didn't need that. Thank you.
Don't make a habit of saving me.

mummy_seen.text: Well, that's new.
Does it shoot back? No? Good.

guardian_seen.text: Now that's a big one.
I'll keep it busy. You think of something.

scarabs.text: Get them off, get them off!

entering_tomb.text: After you. I insist.
Stay sharp. Places like this bite.

idle_explore.text: Are we nearly done looking at walls?
If something moves, I'm shooting it.

idle_city.text: Three men on that corner. Watching us.
Cairo. Never a dull moment.

campfire.text: Don't read anything into me sitting here.
You're not what I expected.

horse_ride.text: Race you.
Faster, or we'll be here all week.

truck_ride.text: Let me drive. I drive better.
Is this as fast as it goes?

act5_escape.text: Don't you dare die in here!

act7_curse.text: The sky's wrong. I don't like it.
Whatever this is, let's finish it.

combat_start.text: Stay low. The sand is your friend.

ally_down.text: A traveller is down! Help them!
We bring them home. All of them.

low_health.text: I am hurt. Keep moving.
Old bones break slower than you think.

mummy_seen.text: The old stories were true, then.
The desert keeps its dead. Not this time.

guardian_seen.text: Do not fight what you cannot kill. Run.
Back! Back the way we came!

entering_tomb.text: We have water, daylight, and a way out. Remember the way out.
Count the turns.

idle_explore.text: The wind is changing.
We are drinking too much water.

idle_city.text: Too many people. Too much noise.
I prefer the desert.

campfire.text: Sleep. Tomorrow is long.
You listen. That is why you will come home.

horse_ride.text: Gently. Save the horses.
Follow my line. Not a step off it.

truck_ride.text: Machines do not know the sand.
Slowly here. Soft ground.

act5_escape.text: Count the turns! Left, then left!

act7_curse.text: The sky has never been this colour.
Even the camels are afraid.

combat_start.text: Let them come! I'm not afraid!

reloading.text: How do you load this thing fast?

ally_down.text: They are down! What do we do?

enemy_down.text: I got one! Did you see?

low_health.text: I'm hurt! It's nothing! It's a lot!
It burns!

helped_up.text: Thank you! I tripped, that's all.

mummy_seen.text: Is that... is that real?
Nobody back home will believe this!

guardian_seen.text: That's the biggest one yet!
I want to go home.

entering_tomb.text: Imagine being the first to see this!
They will write my name on this door!

idle_explore.text: I could scout ahead. I'm fast.
Someone has to find the road. Why not me?

idle_city.text: My uncle lives two streets from here.
Everyone in Cairo will know my name.

campfire.text: Tell me about the other expeditions you've led.
I can't sleep. Too excited.

horse_ride.text: Faster! We can go faster!
I know a quicker way!

truck_ride.text: So slow! A horse would be there already.
Can I sit on the roof?

act7_curse.text: The sky is black at noon!
Is this the end of the world?

combat_start.text: This was not in the contract!

reloading.text: Each bullet costs money, you know.

low_health.text: I'm wounded. Write it in the accounts.
This is very bad for business.

helped_up.text: Thank you. I will remember this, at a discount.

mummy_seen.text: No price for this. None at all.
I did not budget for the dead.

guardian_seen.text: Run! Business is concluded!
No, no, no, no.

scarabs.text: Beetles in the stores! Save the flour!

entering_tomb.text: Every minute here costs us supplies.
A dead customer pays nothing. Be careful.

idle_explore.text: How much do you think that statue weighs?
There is a trader near here who owes me.

idle_city.text: Good prices in this street. Very good.
Let me do the haggling.

campfire.text: We are on budget. Barely.
The sums do not add up. I am staying anyway.

horse_ride.text: The horses are eating our profits.
Water the animals at the next well.

truck_ride.text: Mind the cargo!
Fuel is dear out here.

act7_curse.text: Half the merchants have closed. Terrible.
Fear is very bad for business.

combat_start.text: Men, to the shovels and the stones!

ally_down.text: One of my men is hurt!

entering_tomb.text: Carefully. We dig carefully.
My men will hold the lamps.

idle_explore.text: This soil has been turned before.
The finds are ours to name. Good.

campfire.text: My men are tired, but they are proud.
We have dug for many. Never like this.

mummy_seen.text: God protect us, the dead are digging themselves out!
Back, men!

entering_tomb.text: My men are afraid. So am I.
Lamps up. Stay close.

idle_explore.text: Heavy work. Honest work.
My men know they will be paid. Thank you.

campfire.text: Two of the men are sick from the water.
They ask if they can go home after this.

mummy_seen.text: What is that? What is that?
Run!

entering_tomb.text: Everything is packed for the way out.
Nobody loses a lamp.

idle_explore.text: The camels need rest.
The loads are right. Good.

campfire.text: I always pack for the way out.
The camels are overloaded.

horse_ride.text: Easy, easy with the animals.
Water at the next stop.

mummy_seen.text: God help us!
Back!

combat_start.text: Keep them away from the amulet!

low_health.text: I am hurt. The rite matters more.
I can still sing.

mummy_seen.text: His servants. They know the amulet is here.
They will not touch the eye.

guardian_seen.text: Menkheper. Keep him from the altar!
He comes for the eye. Stand between!

scarabs.text: The scarabs! Do not let them reach the jars!

entering_tomb.text: Walk where I walk.
This is where my family has kept watch for a thousand years.

idle_explore.text: Listen. The tomb is breathing.
Whatever you learned here before, use it now.

low_health.text: It is nothing.
I will not fall here.

mummy_seen.text: The dead are awake. Because of you.
They come.

guardian_seen.text: The guardian himself. Do not let him reach her!
Shoot him, slow him!

entering_tomb.text: You walk on my brothers' graves.
Stay close, foreigner. I will not lose you too.

idle_explore.text: Hurry.
We do not have time for looking.

low_health.text: I'm hurt.
I need a moment.

mummy_seen.text: It's moving!
God help us.

guardian_seen.text: Run!
That's him!

entering_tomb.text: Stay together.
Careful now.

idle_explore.text: Quiet here.
Keep your eyes open.

idle_city.text: Busy today.
Keep close in the crowd.

campfire.text: Long day.
Get some sleep.

horse_ride.text: Easy now.
Keep the pace.

truck_ride.text: Bumpy road.
Hold on.

act7_curse.text: The sky...
Something is coming.
